text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"Haaah... *gasp*... *pant*... Finally, 
it's over...!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
(My throat... hurts. Was breathing always 
this painful...?)

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
(...No, surely it'll be fine. It's always 
been this way. I mean, look, I've still 
gotten results...!)

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
UWOOOOOOOOO! Not yet, not yet! I can still 
keep goinnnng~~!!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Wha?! You've got way too much energy! 
Haaah...

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Wanna do a rematch right here with a quick 
one-lap race?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Wha-!!?? Yes, yes, yes!! I'll do it, I'll 
run myself into the ground!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: You're in too, right, Yaeno!?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: ...If it means competing.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
(So this is an Umamusume with a bright 
future, whose talents are still 
blossoming...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Crack...)

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, I'm back~! That race really gave 
me a lot to think about, didn't it?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Umm, next is...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Next...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
...Excuse me, Trainer. Could I run in 
another GⅠ before the Japan Cup?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"Because Maruzen-san is so strong. Taking 
her on directly like this won't stand a 
chance!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"I know I need more experience. So 
please... I'm begging you!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"True, to be fully prepared for the Japan 
Cup, we really could have used one more 
race."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Preferably at Tokyo Racecourse, just like 
the Japan Cup. Thinking about it that 
way—"
choice_data_list:
What do you think about the Tenno Sho 
(Autumn)?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
...That's the race where I competed 
against Tamamo-san and Oguri-san last 
year.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
...I'll do it. I can do this. And there, I 
will win!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I'll win, and show everyone that I'm an 
Umamusume with potential left in me!!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Hah... *sigh*... Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
"This feeling... it's amazing...! Not bad 
at all—in fact—"

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
...Whew♪ As expected of Maruzen, didn't 
you just regain your peak form?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Oh, that's not true at all. I mean, my 
peak was even more incredible.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
...Still. Fufu, just you watch. Competing 
against Spe-chan brought quite a fruitful 
takeaway.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
I'm in pretty good shape right now, too. 
At this rate, I can run at full throttle 
to the very end.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Ooh~... Maruzen going all out. The time 
has finally come to witness it with my own 
eyes.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, well, yeah. It was probably her 
first time giving it her absolute all.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Your peak is already past, and I thought 
it'd just end without you ever giving it 
your all, but...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
—Nothing like that happened. I'm really 
looking forward to the upcoming Japan Cup.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just before I finished walking Sakura 
Chiyono O back to her dorm, she suddenly 
stopped in her tracks.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Um, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"Could you please keep my current 
condition a secret from the others?"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I managed to get good results in today's 
race as well. So I'm sure I can do my best 
in the next Tenno Sho (Autumn) too!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I wouldn't want people nagging me if they 
found out. Since things are still 
uncertain, I'd rather keep it a secret.
choice_data_list: Got it, I won't tell anyone else.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: ...Thank you very much!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, I'll be fine! So... I'm counting 
on you, okay?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
—I'm sure everyone must have been 
completely exhausted after running all out 
in today's race. It just didn't show on 
their faces, but...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
So that suffering during the race wasn't 
felt by just me. ...I'm sure of it.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
...Please, I'm begging you. I just want to 
believe my peak hasn't passed yet.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Crack-crack... crack)

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"So by next time... by the Tenno Sho 
(Autumn), I just want this weird feeling 
that something's slipping away to be 
gone...!"
